crossRefs.note: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahweh, and against his Anointed…
There is one gone out of you, who devises evil against Yahweh, who counsels wickedness.
After five days, the high priest, Ananias, came down with certain elders and an orator, one Tertullus. They informed…

But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews, and they didn’t make them cease, until the matter should come…

translations.web: They hired counselors against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.
translations.bsb: They hired counselors against them to frustrate their plans throughout the reign of Cyrus king of Persia and down to the reign of Darius king of Persia.
